title: Retrospective Analysis of Predictors of Clinical Outcomes Before and After Left Ventricular Assist Device Implantation – Left Ventricular Assist Device Cohort Essen
summary: Identification of predictors of clinical outcomes following left ventricular assist device (LVAD) implantation based on pre-, peri-, and postoperative routinely collected clinical data. The primary objective is to assess the association of these parameters with all-cause mortality. Exploratory hypothesis: A combination of preoperative parameters derived from echocardiography, invasive hemodynamics, laboratory measurements, and comorbidity profiles predicts clinical outcomes more accurately than established individual risk scores.
conditions: End-stage heart failure requiring left ventricular assist device (LVAD) support

interventions.name: This is a retrospective analysis of routinely collected clinical data. No additional study-specific examinations or interventions will be performed. The study includes patients who underwent implantation of a durable left ventricular assist device (LVAD) at the West German Heart and Vascular Center

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age ≥18 years; implantation of a durable left ventricular assist device (LVAD) at the West German Heart and Vascular Center between January 1, 2016, and September 30, 2026.
Exclusion criteria:
Temporary mechanical circulatory support without subsequent durable LVAD implantation; total artificial heart implantation.
